summary: Documentation-only commit 47a2163 was verified claim-by-claim against the code at that commit: field names and types (Group.title, Board.groupOrder), schema version 8, the 40-character title cap, DEFAULT_FULL_WIDTH values in the data.json example, CSS values (order: 100, max-height: 80vh, overflow-y: auto, opacity: 0.5, ellipsis rules), all three test attributes and their host elements, the illustrative resolveGroupTitle/BoardLayout listings, Node engines vs README, and every test count in docs/testing/infrastructure.md (unit 111 in 7 files — reproduced locally in 304 ms; e2e 99 in 5 files; per-file counts all exact). Two issues stand out: one absolute claim in the sanitization section is contradicted by migration.ts, and the task's Post-completion decisions-log entry (including the drift findings the task explicitly asks to record) has not been written. Style fit is good — Russian prose, bold sub-headings, `---` separators, one-mechanism-one-place with a cross-reference from the popup section to the layout section.

suggestions.suggestion: The sentence «Названия групп и порядок групп — единственные поля, которые проверяются при каждой загрузке, а не один раз в версионной ветке» is wrong as an absolute. src/data/migration.ts:84-87 contains a second unconditional per-load fixup outside every version branch: `if (result.settings.cardView === undefined) { result.settings.cardView = DEFAULT_SETTINGS.cardView; }`. The rest of the section (why sanitization sits outside the version branch, what invariants it holds) is accurate and matches migration.ts:151-159 line by line — only the superlative is false. Drop «единственные» (e.g. «проверяются при каждой загрузке, а не один раз в версионной ветке» / «единственные поля, которые санируются при каждой загрузке»), or name the cardView backfill as the other unconditional check.
suggestions.benefit: The section's whole point is that this differs from every other migration in the file; a reader who later finds the cardView line concludes the document is unreliable exactly where it claims to be precise.

suggestions.suggestion: The Post-completion block of task 12 is not done: the decisions log ends with the Task 11 entry (the only uncommitted addition to that file is Task 11's report), there is no Task 12 entry. The task requires: a short report, plus a separate item listing the documentation drift found but deliberately not fixed, plus the CHANGELOG gap for schema version 6 (settings.cardLayout / multi-column card layout is absent from both CHANGELOG.md and CHANGELOG.ru.md), plus the finding that tests/unit/ is outside `npx tsc --noEmit` scope (that one is already written into docs/testing/infrastructure.md but still owed to the log). Concrete drift found during this review and worth recording: docs/technical.md:111 still declares `type Status = 'new' | 'inProgress' | 'waiting' | 'completed'` while src/data/types.ts:4 also has `'meeting'` — this is inside the same TypeScript code fence that the task edited; docs/technical.md:365-386 keeps the pre-existing simplified migrateData listing that omits the `< 2`, `< 3`, `< 5` branches (the task explicitly sanctioned adding only `< 8`, so leaving it is correct, but it is drift).
suggestions.benefit: Closes the acceptance criterion «всякое расхождение реализации со спекой описано в decisions log» and hands the next feature the list of known documentation gaps instead of making it rediscover them.

suggestions.suggestion: «Строки идут в порядке доски (`board.groupOrder`)» is a half-truth: BoardSettingsPopup.svelte:41-43 renders `presentGroups` — `groupOrder` filtered by `hasOwnProperty` + truthiness of the group object — and the arrows operate on that filtered list too (`handleMove` → `moveGroupWithinPresent(groupOrder, presentGroups, ...)`, line 47). The document already explains the missing-group case at line 475 («Такие идентификаторы BoardLayout и BoardSettingsPopup просто не рисуют»), so one clause («…в порядке доски, за вычетом идентификаторов без объекта группы — см. «Санация полей на каждой загрузке»») closes the gap without duplicating the mechanism.
suggestions.benefit: Keeps the popup description consistent with the sanitization section that the same file already carries.

suggestions.suggestion: The consistency guarantee is attributed to «`canMoveGroup` и `moveGroup` в `src/ui/groupOrderUtils.ts`», but the popup never calls `moveGroup`: it calls `moveGroupWithinPresent` (groupOrderUtils.ts:124), which itself is built on `canMoveGroup`/`moveGroup` over `presentGroups`. The claim is therefore true but names the wrong pair for this call site. Either name `moveGroupWithinPresent` or phrase it as «предикат и перестановка построены на общем помощнике `findSwap`».
suggestions.benefit: A reader following the reference into groupOrderUtils.ts finds the function the popup actually uses instead of concluding the doc is out of date.

suggestions.suggestion: «Arrows move a group up or down, stepping over hidden ones» / «Стрелки перемещают группу вверх или вниз, перешагивая скрытые» describes only the visible-row case. groupOrderUtils.ts:58-61 moves a hidden row literally, to the adjacent slot regardless of the neighbour's visibility — which is precisely why the next clause about hidden groups keeping their positions works. Both languages carry the identical simplification, so the two entries stay in sync; if you tighten one, tighten the other. Otherwise the entries match sentence for sentence in content and detail — no action strictly required for a changelog.
suggestions.benefit: Removes the only place where the changelog states a rule the code applies to one of two row kinds.

suggestions.suggestion: The project-structure block adds `docs/specs/`, `docs/plans/`, `docs/testing/` but omits `docs/features/` — the directory this feature's own artifacts (user-spec, tech-spec, tasks, decisions log) live in, and the one a reader is most likely to look for. `docs/screenshots/` is also absent, which matters less.
suggestions.benefit: The structure block is the one place a newcomer scans for «where do feature documents live»; the answer is currently missing.

suggestions.suggestion: The illustrative `migrateV7toV8()` follows the file's existing convention (migrateV3toV4, migrateV5toV6, migrateV6toV7 do not exist as functions either — migration.ts inlines every branch in `migrateData`). The listing's body is faithful to migration.ts:137-149, so this is acceptable, but if the file is ever touched again it is worth a one-line note that the vN→vM functions are a presentation device, not real symbols.
suggestions.benefit: Prevents a future reader from grepping for a function name that has never existed in src/.
